infra.logs.editor.label: Query
infra.logs.editor.hint: Pick log groups, write a query, then press Run (⌘/Ctrl+Enter). While it runs, ⌘/Ctrl+. cancels. AWOG never runs on its own.
infra.logs.window.label: Time range
infra.logs.window.sendToMonitoringHint: Carries this exact window to the Monitoring tab
infra.logs.window.invalid: The time range is invalid: the end must be after the start.
infra.logs.streams.title: Log streams
infra.logs.groups.title: Log groups
infra.logs.groups.empty: No log group matches. Try another prefix, or this account has no logs yet.
infra.logs.tail.truncated: more lines exist — narrow the window or filter
infra.logs.tail.rateNote: Latest lines uses filter-log-events — billed per request, NOT per GB scanned like Insights.
infra.logs.tail.pickGroup: Click a log group above to see its latest lines.
infra.logs.tail.emptyGroup: This group has no lines in the selected time range.
infra.logs.run.histogram: Include the density chart (runs one extra query)
infra.logs.run.rateNote: CloudWatch Insights charges 0.005 USD per GB scanned, not per returned row. A narrower window and fewer log groups cost less.
infra.logs.results.empty: No rows yet. Pick a log group and press Run to start.
infra.logs.hist.title: Log density over time
infra.logs.hist.fromRows: built from the run you just did
infra.logs.hist.empty: Nothing to draw yet. The chart appears after a run.
infra.logs.hist.zoomed: Time range set to the selection — press Run to look at it
infra.logs.filters.insertHint: Add this filter to the query
infra.logs.library.title: Query library
infra.logs.mode.tailFull: Latest log lines of one group
infra.logs.mode.traceFull: Trace one request across its hops
infra.logs.streams.pickHint: Pick a stream to read its log lines.
infra.logs.streams.allHint: Every stream in this group, merged
infra.logs.tail.emptyStream: This stream has no lines in the selected time range.
infra.logs.results.openRow: Click to see this row in full
infra.logs.row.title: Log event
infra.logs.prefs.hint: Choose how row details open, line wrapping and visible columns
infra.logs.prefs.title: Preferences
infra.logs.prefs.rowMode.paneDesc: Details open in a pane of their own, one row at a time. The table keeps its height.
infra.logs.prefs.rowMode.inlineDesc: Details sit under the row, and several rows can be open at once for comparison.
infra.logs.prefs.wrapLinesDesc: Show the whole value instead of truncating it. In exchange, one long log line takes up a lot of the table.
infra.logs.prefs.noColumns: No results yet, so there are no columns to choose.
infra.logs.prefs.lastColumn: At least one column has to stay visible.
